patient.name: 伊兹米·柯蒂斯
patient.diagnosis: 成年医疗 AU：人体炼成旧伤导致部分脏器确实缺失、残存消化道严重黏连和局部牵拉性疼痛。计划在保护侧支血供的前提下，实施有限范围黏连松解及局部消化道重建；不会使已缺失的器官复生。
patient.diagnosis_en: Adult medical AU: Old injuries from human transmutation have left genuine organ loss, extensive adhesions around preserved bowel, and symptomatic traction. Planned treatment is targeted adhesiolysis and local digestive-tract reconstruction while preserving collateral supply; missing organs cannot be restored.

day1.title: 比病历还难解释
day1.title_en: Harder to Explain Than the Chart

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 坂口把超声、CT 影像和一份折痕很多的转诊资料摊在桌面上。伊兹米坐在对面，一只手按着腹部，表情很不耐烦。
lines.text_en: Sakaguchi spreads ultrasound and CT images and a heavily creased referral document across the desk. Izumi sits opposite him, one hand pressed against her abdomen, looking very impatient.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「这些部位都受过很严重的损伤。……以前出过车祸？」
lines.text_en: “These areas have sustained severe damage. ...Were you in a traffic accident?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「没有。」
lines.text_en: “No.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「也不像一次普通的开腹手术留下的。」
lines.text_en: “It doesn't look like the aftermath of an ordinary abdominal operation, either.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「人体炼成。」
lines.text_en: “Human transmutation.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text_en: “...What?”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我知道这话很难相信。别追问了，反正已经过去很多年。」
lines.text_en: “I know that sounds impossible. Don't ask me to explain. It happened years ago.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 坂口看了她一眼，又把目光转回影像。
lines.text_en: Sakaguchi glances at her, then turns his attention back to the images.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「好。我不追问。但要确认现在哪些器官还在、哪些位置有血流，以及为什么反复疼痛。」
lines.text_en: “All right. I won't press you. But I need to establish which organs remain, where blood still flows, and what causes the recurring pain.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「这才像医生该问的。」
lines.text_en: “Now those are the questions a doctor should ask.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「我们不会把你整个腹腔里的黏连都拆开。很多地方现在的血供，可能反而靠着这些旧关系维持。」
lines.text_en: “We won't pull apart every adhesion in your abdomen. Some of those old connections may now be essential to the remaining blood supply.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「所以你准备把我打开，仔仔细细地挑出那些能碰的地方？」
lines.text_en: “So you're going to open me up and pick out, very carefully, the parts you can safely touch?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「对。会是一台很长的手术。」
lines.text_en: “Exactly. It will be a long operation.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……啧。我以前总嫌学生们一遇上点事就哆嗦。现在轮到我了。」
lines.text_en: “...Tch. I used to get annoyed when my pupils shook over the smallest thing. Now it's my turn.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「会全身麻醉。手术中你不必自己撑着。」
lines.text_en: “You'll be under general anesthesia. You won't have to endure the operation awake.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「我当然知道全麻是什么。可我明天睁开眼睛时，肚子已经被你们折腾过十几个小时了吧？」
lines.text_en: “I know what general anesthesia is. But by the time I open my eyes tomorrow, you'll have been working inside my abdomen for hours, won't you?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「是。所以今天把问题问清楚。」
lines.text_en: “Yes. That's why we're going through your questions today.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那就最后一个问题。你会把我的身体修好到哪一步？」
lines.text_en: “Then one last question. How much of my body can you actually put right?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「把能保留的组织修好，让你少疼、少出血、能重新正常过日子。失去的部分，我没办法变出来。」
lines.text_en: “I'll repair what can be preserved, reduce your pain and bleeding, and help you live normally again. I can't recreate what you've lost.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 伊兹米低头看着腹部，过了片刻才抬起头。
lines.text_en: Izumi looks down at her abdomen and raises her head again after a moment.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……行。那就把我剩下的这些东西，给我好好照顾着。」
lines.text_en: “...Fine. Then take good care of what I have left.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 坂口合上影像报告，手术计划及需要重点保护的结构显示在病历卡上。镜头切至高级手术团队编组界面。
lines.text_en: Sakaguchi closes the imaging report. The surgical plan and the structures requiring particular protection appear on the medical chart. The view shifts to the advanced surgery team selection screen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 伊兹米醒着，正对着床边的水杯发呆。看见坂口进来，她立刻坐直了一点。
lines.text_en: Izumi is awake, staring blankly at the cup of water beside her bed. When she sees Sakaguchi enter, she immediately sits a little straighter.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「好了？那台听起来没完没了的手术。」
lines.text_en: “Finished? That operation that sounded like it would never end?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「完成了。主要牵拉点处理了，薄弱的消化道组织也修复了。血供检查结果稳定。」
lines.text_en: “It's finished. We addressed the main points of traction, repaired fragile digestive tissue, and confirmed stable blood supply.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「那我缺的东西呢？」
lines.text_en: “And the things I'm missing?”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「缺的还是缺的。我不会拿这个骗你。」
lines.text_en: “They're still missing. I won't lie to you about that.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 伊兹米沉默片刻，突然笑了一声。
lines.text_en: Izumi falls silent for a moment, then suddenly lets out a laugh.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「哼。我就知道。要是你能凭空给我长出几个器官，我倒要问问你是不是炼金术师了。」
lines.text_en: “Hmph. I knew it. If you could make organs grow out of thin air, I'd have to ask whether you were an alchemist.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「接下来还要循序恢复饮食，别逞强。」
lines.text_en: “You'll need to resume eating gradually. Don't push yourself.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「知道了。我丈夫还等着我回去呢。」
lines.text_en: “I know. My husband's waiting for me to come home.”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「那就先把这段恢复期过好。」
lines.text_en: “Then concentrate on getting through recovery first.”

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: 「……谢了，医生。以后再有人问我怎么弄伤的，我还是会说人体炼成。」
lines.text_en: “...Thanks, Doctor. If anyone asks how I was injured, I'm still going to say 'human transmutation.'”

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: 「……我会在病历里用比较容易让同事理解的写法。」
lines.text_en: “...I'll use wording in the chart that my colleagues can understand.”

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 她笑着摆摆手，重新靠回枕头。进入现有 Day 3 成功结算画面。
lines.text_en: Smiling, she waves a hand and settles back against her pillow. Proceed to the existing Day 3 success results screen.
